metadata.description: Cloud FinOps Skill & MCP by OptimNow: reference library, named-pattern playbooks, and a queryable MCP server.

plugins.name: cloud-finops
plugins.description:
Expert FinOps guidance for cloud, AI, SaaS and data-platform spend. Ask Claude how to reduce a bill, size a commitment, allocate shared costs or justify AI spend, and it answers with billing mechanics, decision rules and worked examples, not generic advice.

Cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI and Kubernetes, including Savings Plans, Reserved Instances and Azure Hybrid Benefit.
AI: Anthropic, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, open-weight model APIs, AI coding tools, agent cost per task, self-hosted vs managed inference.
Data platforms: Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric.
FinOps practice: allocation, showback and chargeback, tagging, anomalies, KPIs, workload onboarding, SaaS and IT asset management, GreenOps.

Waste playbooks: 41 runbooks for specific waste patterns such as idle NAT gateways, orphaned disks, snapshot sprawl, unused reservations, oversized GPUs and coding-agent token waste. Each gives a detection query to run in your own account, the fix, and a confidence level.

Good to know: this plugin adds instructions only and does not connect to your cloud accounts. Open source (CC BY-SA 4.0), maintained by OptimNow and updated twice a month.
